title: Stare at this blue banana for 12 seconds
pause_note: Shorts v4: DO + COUNTDOWN hook, 12 s stare, white reveal, loop ending

beats: Stare at the dot on this blue banana.
Nothing on your screen is yellow.
Staring wore down the cells in your eyes that sense blue.
On white, the blue signal is weak, so yellow wins.
Look back at the dot and try it again.
